pages.purpose: Checks ordinary symbol substitution and assignment around a Table Table fixture, without fixture-managed symbol handling.
pages.recommendedDisposition: Implemented as a separate ordinary-mode fixture; the consumer-managed fixture remains distinct.
pages.rootCause: The ordinary TableTableIncFirstCol fixture was absent. Once added, imports of fitnesse.slim.test could mask the more specific statementexecutorconsumer fixture because the page also imports the parent package from included content. Preferring the most-specific imported package resolves the managed fixture without aliasing modes. Ordinary row inputs are substituted by the existing executor before one doTable call; FitNesse applies output-cell symbol assignments after the returned rows, so same-table assignments do not affect later rows.
